title: Impact of Higher Electricity and Ingredient Prices on Earnings of Hawkers
what_it_is: Impact of Higher Electricity and Ingredient Prices on Earnings of Hawkers

sections.label: Hawker support and relief measures
sections.summary: Footfall is improving; Government gave hawkers rental waivers, subsidies and payouts, and SFA-licensed operators and stallholders receive payouts for local employees.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: However, the footfall of hawker centres has been improving following the easing of safe management measures and is expected to further improve with more employees returning to their workplaces and the opening up of Singapore to travel from overseas visitors under the Vaccinated Travel Framework.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We do not keep track of hawkers’ earnings as they are self-employed persons.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To mitigate the impact of COVID-19, the Government provided hawkers with 10 months of rental waiver and six months of subsidies for table-cleaning and centralised dishwashing services in 2020 and 2021, as well as a one-off cash payout of $500 under the Market and Hawker Centre Relief Fund in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: SFA-licensed operators and stallholders in hawker centres, markets, coffee shops, food courts and canteens will receive $1,000 for each local employee receiving mandatory CPF contributions, capped at $10,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Those without local employees will receive a flat payout of $1,000.

sections.label: CDC vouchers for households
sections.summary: Each Singaporean household will receive $100 worth of CDC vouchers this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Each Singaporean household will receive $100 worth of CDC vouchers this year.

sections.label: Hawker stall rental review
sections.summary: At the upcoming April to June review, 96% of hawker stalls face no rental revision or a reduction, with only about 6% increased, capped at about $300.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Actually, when the leases come up for review, the majority – in fact, for the upcoming review from April to June – 96% of the hawker stalls that are up for rental review are either going to experience no rental revision or, actually, a rental reduction.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, 58% of those are rental reduction and only about 6% or so, or 14 stalls, would have a rental revision upwards, but that is moderated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, any rental revision upwards is moderated, capped at about $300, whereas a rental reduction is between $20 and $2,400-odd.
